subject: Thanks for the help at Nanshan store
body: Hi, I just wanted to say thanks. I was at your Shenzhen Nanshan store last weekend looking at linen shirts and the staff member who helped me was really patient while I tried on a few sizes. She gave honest advice about the fit and didn't rush me at all. I ended up buying one and I'm really happy with it. Please pass on my thanks to the team there.
